title: The Last Shelf
description: The last shelf holds the archive's one unfinished
entry: a record of this descent, in this hand, with
the final line left blank. The librarian has been
holding the quill out for a thousand blocks.
The far shore is next, and it is not under the world
any more. The archive keeps a door that was never a
portal and a portal that was never a door, and the
difference is the End of the map.
